feeds.title: Vintage Camper Trailers Blog
feeds.description: For all admirers, dreamers, collectors and restorers of vintage camper trailers and mid-century memorabilia. In 2012 the authors started the first publication in the United States dedicated to rescuing, restoring and rallying with mid-century trailers of all shapes and sizes.

feeds.title: Little Vintage Trailer
feeds.description: A blog about vintage trailers and glamping. Little Vintage Trailer is where you can find trailers for sale, read tutorials, and all things vintage camping related.

feeds.title: Good Old RVs Blog
feeds.description: Explore the blog for everything on vintage RVs, stories from people around the world, reviews of RVs and more.
